scope: Stock PostgreSQL Python delivery: complete logical inventories and encoded carriers, bounded query shapes, supported host/database deadlines. Component limits remain capped by enclosing selected logical limits.
refusal: Refuse when an observable selected limit is exceeded; contain effects and preserve prior caller work. Never truncate required meaning.
openOutputs: implementation and focused evidence for selected observable limits
complete native finalization and unavoidable commit validation

enforcement.inventory: complete logical row counts; no limiting query or skipped occurrence
enforcement.carriers: raw/encoded byte limits with known hex/Base64 expansion; no exact hidden allocation claim
enforcement.queries: selected bounded query shapes and complete results
enforcement.deadlines: supported host operation deadlines and database statement timeouts; not an unavoidable cumulative account across arbitrary caller SQL or rollback
enforcement.rollback: native state follows transaction rollback; no nonrefunded historical work ledger
